title: Bucket deletion does not delete entries below intermediate child direcotries/entries
body:
Sponsors SeaweedFS via Patreon https://www.patreon.com/seaweedfs
Report issues here. Ask questions here https://stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/seaweedfs
Please ask questions in https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/discussions

**Describe the bug**
The issue is very easy to reproduce.
1. Create a bucket

```
❯ s3cmd mb s3://test-bucket
Bucket 's3://test-bucket/' created
```
2. Put some files several levels down in the bucket.

```
❯ s3cmd put file1.txt s3://test-bucket/dir1/file1.txt
WARNING: Module python-magic is not available. Guessing MIME types based on file extensions.
upload: 'file1.txt' -> 's3://test-bucket/dir1/file1.txt'  [1 of 1]
 0 of 0     0% in    0s     0.00 B/s  done
❯ s3cmd put file2.txt s3://test-bucket/dir1/dir2/file2.txt
WARNING: Module python-magic is not available. Guessing MIME types based on file extensions.
upload: 'file2.txt' -> 's3://test-bucket/dir1/dir2/file2.txt'  [1 of 1]
 0 of 0     0% in    0s     0.00 B/s  done
❯ s3cmd put file3.txt s3://test-bucket/dir1/dir2/dir3/file3.txt
WARNING: Module python-magic is not available. Guessing MIME types based on file extensions.
upload: 'file3.txt' -> 's3://test-bucket/dir1/dir2/dir3/file3.txt'  [1 of 1]
 0 of 0     0% in    0s     0.00 B/s  done
❯ s3cmd ls --recursive s3://test-bucket/
2024-12-09 19:52            0  s3://test-bucket/dir1/dir2/dir3/file3.txt
2024-12-09 19:52            0  s3://test-bucket/dir1/dir2/file2.txt
2024-12-09 19:52            0  s3://test-bucket/dir1/file1.txt
```

3. Delete the bucket

```
❯ s3cmd rb s3://test-bucket
Bucket 's3://test-bucket/' removed
```

4. The metadata of the entries below intermediate child still remain

```
❯ s3cmd ls --recursive s3://test-bucket/
ERROR: Bucket 'test-bucket' does not exist
ERROR: S3 error: 404 (NoSuchBucket): The specified bucket does not exist
❯ s3cmd ls --recursive s3://test-bucket/dir1/
ERROR: Bucket 'test-bucket' does not exist
ERROR: S3 error: 404 (NoSuchBucket): The specified bucket does not exist
❯ s3cmd ls --recursive s3://test-bucket/dir1/dir2/
2024-12-09 19:52            0  s3://test-bucket/dir1/dir2/dir3/file3.txt
2024-12-09 19:52            0  s3://test-bucket/dir1/dir2/file2.txt
❯ s3cmd ls --recursive s3://test-bucket/dir1/dir2/dir3/
2024-12-09 19:52            0  s3://test-bucket/dir1/dir2/dir3/file3.txt
```

We could still find the metadata of these remaining entries
```
root [ /data ]# weed shell
> cd buckets
> cd test-bucket
error: /buckets/test-bucket is not a directory
> cd test-bucket/dir1
error: /buckets/test-bucket/dir1 is not a directory
> cd test-bucket/dir1/dir2
> ls
dir3
file2.txt
> fs.meta.cat file2.txt
{
  "name":  "file2.txt",
  "isDirectory":  false,
  "chunks":  [],
  "attributes":  {
    "fileSize":  "0",
    "mtime":  "1733773951",
    "fileMode":  432,
    "uid":  0,
    "gid":  0,
    "crtime":  "1733773951",
    "mime":  "text/plain",
    "ttlSec":  0,
    "userName":  "",
    "groupName":  [],
    "symlinkTarget":  "",
    "md5":  "1B2M2Y8AsgTpgAmY7PhCfg==",
    "rdev":  0,
    "inode":  "0"
  },
  "extended":  {
    "X-Amz-Meta-S3cmd-Attrs":  "YXRpbWU6MTczMzc3Mzc5MC9jdGltZToxNzMzNzczODIxL2dpZDoyMC9nbmFtZTpzdGFmZi9tZDU6ZDQxZDhjZDk4ZjAwYjIwNGU5ODAwOTk4ZWNmODQyN2UvbW9kZTozMzE4OC9tdGltZToxNzMzNzczNzkwL3VpZDo1MDEvdW5hbWU6eWl4aW5nY2hlbmc=",
    "x-amz-storage-class":  "U1RBTkRBUkQ="
  },
  "hardLinkId":  "",
  "hardLinkCounter":  0,
  "content":  "",
  "remoteEntry":  null,
  "quota":  "0"
}chunks 0 meta size: 264 gzip:267
>
```

Note, this issue is only observed when delete the bucket. When delete a directory in the bucket, the recursive deletion works for all entries in it.

This problem gives us a lot of issues because in some of our use cases, the bucket with the same name will be deleted and recreated. And we do see inconsistent filer metadata over the course.


**System Setup**
1. Helm chart deployment with 3.79 helm chart release
2. Seaweedfs 3.79 in aligh with helm chart release
3. Default to filer configuration, recursive_delete: false
4.
```
root [ /etc/seaweedfs ]# cat filer.toml
[leveldb2]
enabled = true
dir = "/data/filerldb2"
```

**Expected behavior**
When delete a bucket, which is recursive deletion, all the metadata of its child entries should be all deleted.
